note: Fictional sample data for a course project. Not a live repository.

issues.title: App crashes when saving a note with an emoji in the title
issues.author: maria-dev
issues.body: Steps: create a new note, type a title containing an emoji, press Save. The app closes immediately. Happens on version 1.3.0 on both Android and iOS. Notes without emoji save fine.

comments.author: kenji-t
comments.text: Same here. The crash log shows an encoding error in the title field.

comments.author: maintainer-ana
comments.text: Confirmed. Probably the title is stored with the wrong character encoding.

issues.title: Add dark mode
issues.author: lee-s
issues.body: Please add a dark theme. The white background is hard to use at night.

issues.title: Sync creates duplicate notes
issues.author: omar-k
issues.body: After syncing two devices, every note appears twice.

issues.title: Search finds nothing for words with accents
issues.author: chloe-r
issues.body: Searching for 'cafe' finds my notes, but searching for 'café' returns no results, even though the note contains 'café'.

comments.author: kenji-t
comments.text: Looks like search does not normalize accented characters.

issues.title: How do I export notes to PDF?
issues.author: priya-n
issues.body: Is there a way to export a note as a PDF? I could not find it in the menu.

issues.title: Login session expires after 5 minutes on Android
issues.author: david-m
issues.body: On Android, I am logged out about 5 minutes after logging in, every time. On iOS the session lasts for days.

comments.author: maintainer-ana
comments.text: The Android token refresh may be failing silently. Needs investigation.

issues.title: Add keyboard shortcuts
issues.author: lee-s
issues.body: Ctrl+N for a new note and Ctrl+F for search would be helpful.

issues.title: Typo on settings page: 'Prefrences'
issues.author: sam-w
issues.body: The settings page heading says 'Prefrences' instead of 'Preferences'.
